critical_code_review_comments: voice.py parse-number: except (json.JSONDecodeError, Exception) is redundant since Exception already catches JSONDecodeError — harmless but a tuple with a broad Exception traps everything including HTTPException chains. Consider narrowing to (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, RuntimeError) so the timeout HTTPException path is preserved (currently it is, because TimeoutError is caught earlier, but a nested asyncio.TimeoutError from within send_message would be swallowed as 500).

FieldMicButton: recorded blob rejected when size<800 bytes prevents accidental empties — good; however the toast label always says 'cm' even when the field is a fixedUnit '°' angle if unit==='°' path is taken. Verified conditional handles this ('°' branch), OK.

server.py FREEMIUM_WALL_LIMIT=10 and /api/limits both consistent. Confirm the same constant is referenced in Register subtitle / Landing / Precos / Legal frontend strings (source grep shows only preview_plugin html still contains 'Tudo Mais Fácil' — internal SketchUp assets, acceptable).

preview_plugin/lastro.html and modulo.html still say 'Tudo Mais Fácil' in <title> — these are shipped inside the SketchUp plugin HtmlDialog UIs. Not user-facing on the PWA, but if strict anonymity is required, rebrand these too.
